# Drone News 48h Brief — August 17, 2026

_Window: last 48 hours; 75 incidents._

## Summary
In the past 48 hours, several drone incidents, primarily revolving around terrorism and unauthorized operations, have occurred predominantly in the Kurdish regions of Iraq, where drone strikes have targeted the Prime Minister's office. Reports suggest Iranian involvement, heightening tensions. Concurrently, security forces in the U.S. have utilized drones to assist in arrests and to address illicit activities along the Texas border. Notably, NATO jets have engaged drones breaching Romanian airspace amid rising security threats. The eventful period underscores increasing concerns over drone terrorism and smuggling activities, along with the regulatory efforts to mitigate risks associated with unauthorized drone flights.
